messages:
Sam (growth): Need a tight narrative for the launch flipbook + webinar. want a single visual and 2 CTAs that map latency <-> $ impact.
Ivy (design): Propose a compact flipbook hero: left panel = latency curve, middle = cost curve, right = recommended configuration. micro-animation for webinar only.
Rafael (analytics): I'll compute cost per 1k tokens and median latency across short/med/long contexts for top models. will output a small CSV + chart.
Pri (product): Messaging focus: predictability + levers. Suggest lead line: "Control responsiveness. Control spend." keep it punchy.
Ethan (ops): Ops note: include a small explainer about prefix/KV caching and routing weights. our sim shows prefix cache saves ~12-18% tokens for chat workloads.
Sam (growth): CTA split idea: CTA-A = "See latency in action" (drives demos), CTA-B = "Estimate my cost" (drives trials). test which converts better.
Ivy (design): For social cards keep under 8 words. propose: "Fast when it matters. Affordable always."
Rafael (analytics): A/B plan: randomize 30/30 holdback on landing. Track MQL, demo requests, request-a-quote. I'll add 'latency_priority' checkbox on form and a free-text field.
Pri (product): SDR routing: if latency_priority=true OR use_case contains "realtime" -> route to Dedicated-specialist queue. Otherwise go to growth nurture. Add short SDR script lines.
Ethan (ops): Will provide the safe ranges phrasing: "typical median latency" and include the fallback behavior. no absolute SLA promises.
Sam (growth): Ownership: I'll draft the flipbook copy + webinar script. Ivy design assets. Rafael dashboards + UTM. Pri will do the SDR playbook. Ethan ops verifies numbers.
DeployBot: Reminder: marketing staging site deployed at 1751240100. preview link available.
Ivy (design): Timeline: first wireframes tomorrow, animated storyboard by Wed. keep animated frames lightweight for live demo.
Rafael (analytics): Shared drive with CSV and chart soon: https://drive.mock/redwood/marketing/latency_dollars_flip.csv
Sam (growth): Final: prioritize latency-first creative in paid channels, cost-first in email nurture. capture 'latency_priority' for routing. sync Friday to validate metrics. thanks!
Pri (product): One more: let's prep a 1-slide mini-case showing cost savings at 10k qps with and without prefix caching. saves the narrative in one glance.
Ethan (ops): I'll add the sim assumptions and the routing weight snippet for the one-pager.
Sam (growth): Perfect. meeting adjourned.
